# SigCat repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

Before making code changes, read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md`, and the relevant requirements in `docs/PRD.md`.

`docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md` is the single source of truth for implementation progress. Use a stable task ID; mark work in progress, blockers and the next task; link test/benchmark/hardware evidence before checking a task complete. Follow all security, local-first, receive-only and provenance guardrails in `AGENTS.md`. Never claim undocumented hardware, Docker, decoder or AI performance.
